Class SocketServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.socket.server.SocketServer
public class SocketServer extends Object
TCP Socket server. Accepts incoming connections and spawns a SocketClientHandler per client. Shares the same LobbyManager as RmiServer so players using different transports can participate in the same game. Started by CombinedServer.
